info.name: WarmDesk API
info.description: Postman mirror of docs/bruno. Import the matching environment (WarmDesk Local or WarmDesk Production), run Login — the test script saves access_token as `token` on the active environment (same behaviour as the Bruno Login post-response script).

request.description: Requires global admin role.
global_role: "admin", "user", "viewer", "metrics", or "backup"

Creates a timestamped backup in the ./backups/ directory.
  Also accessible via POST /api/v1/backup with a backup-role API key.

Logs in and automatically stores the access_token in the token environment variable.
  If MFA is enabled, the response contains mfa_required: true and an mfa_token — use
  the MFA Verify request to complete login.
The full key (cwk_...) is returned once only — save it immediately.

priority: "none", "low", "medium", or "high"

request.description: Copy or move a card to a column in another project. action: copy|move (required); sub_cards: move|detach. A move keeps the card (comments, checklist, attachments, history), gives it a new number in the target project, and keeps the old key resolvable. Response includes key, previous_key and moved_sub_card_ids.
time_spent_minutes: optional; logged time appears in time reports
Returns every column transition for this card with timestamp and user.

Daily card counts per column over the given period.

Distribution of time each card spent in progress (first move → closed).

Partial update; requires member access. Only fields present are changed. {{cardId}} may be the numeric id or the card key (e.g. ANSI-4).
Fields: title, description, priority (none/low/medium/high/critical), closed (true/false), start_date / due_date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339, null clears), story_points (null clears).
Unknown or invalid fields return 400 and change nothing.

item.name: Transfer Card to Another Project (Ticket API)

request.description:
Move (default) or copy a card to a lane in another project; requires member access to both projects, and a project key must be scoped to the target project. {{cardId}} may be the numeric id or the card key (e.g. ANSI-4).
Fields: target_project (slug, required), column_id or column (lane in the target project, required), action (move/copy), sub_cards (move/detach).
A move keeps comments, checklist, attachments and history; the card is renumbered in the target project and its old key keeps resolving.
